title: Core Web Vitals
definition: Core Web Vitals are an initiative by Google providing unified metrics to measure user experience on the web. They primarily focus on loading speed (LCP), interactivity (INP), and visual stability (CLS).
simpleExplanation: Google's official report card for your website. If you fail, Google pushes your site down in the search rankings.
